title: On the Architectural Complexity of Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2605.04325v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce a unified theoretical framework for the rigorous analysis and systematic construction of deep neural networks (DNNs). This framework addresses a gap in existing theory by explicitly modeling the structure of tensor operations -- lower level information that is often abstracted. Our framework enables two novel objectives: (1) analysis of the evolution of architectural complexity over deep learning history, and (2) automatic construction of novel architectures based on new types of tensor operations. Our study of DNNs introduced over the past 40 years reveals a connection between groundbreaking architectures and increases in different types of architectural complexity. Moreover, we identify several large classes of higher complexity architectures that have not yet been explored. We then collect a dataset of 3,000+ higher complexity architectures, which we publicly release at: https://github.com/combinatoriallabs/Architectu

translated_title: 论神经网络的架构复杂性
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个统一的理论框架，用于对深度神经网络进行严谨分析与系统构建。该框架通过显式建模张量运算的结构——这一通常被抽象化处理的底层信息——填补了现有理论的空白。我们的框架实现了两个新颖的目标：（1）分析深度学习历史中架构复杂性的演变，以及（2）基于新型张量运算自动构建新架构。我们对过去40年间提出的深度神经网络的研究表明，突破性架构与不同类型架构复杂性的提升之间存在联系。此外，我们识别出几大类尚未被探索的更高复杂度架构。随后，我们收集了一个包含3000多个更高复杂度架构的数据集，并将其公开发布于：https://github.com/combinatoriallabs/Architectu
tldr: 提出了一个通过显式建模张量运算结构来统一分析和构建深度神经网络的理论框架，揭示了突破性架构与架构复杂性提升之间的联系，并发布了包含3000多个高复杂度架构的数据集。
en_tdlr: We introduce a unified theoretical framework that explicitly models tensor operation structures to analyze the evolution of neural network architectural complexity and automatically construct novel architectures, revealing connections between groundbreaking architectures and increased complexity.
